en.t: Roman emperor Caligula accepts the titles of the Principate, bestowed on him by the Senate
en.s: The Roman emperor was the ruler of the Roman Empire, starting with the granting of the title augustus to Octavian in 27 BC. The title of imperator, originally a military honorific, was usually used alongside caesar, originally a cognomen. When a given Roman is described as becoming emperor in English, it generally reflects his accession as augustus, and later as basileus.

zh.t: 罗马皇帝卡利古拉接受元老院授予的元首头衔
zh.s: 罗马皇帝是罗马帝国的统治者；公元前27年，屋大维获授“奥古斯都”称号，罗马皇帝制度由此开始。“统帅”（imperator）原本是军事荣誉称号，通常与最初为家族名的“恺撒”（Caesar）一同使用。英文中说某人成为罗马皇帝，通常指其即位为奥古斯都，后期则称巴西琉斯。

en.t: After assassinating the Roman Emperor Pertinax, his Praetorian Guards auction off the throne to Didius Julianus
en.s: The Praetorian Guard (Latin: cohortes praetoriae) was the imperial guard of the Imperial Roman army that served various roles for the Roman emperor including being a bodyguard unit, counterintelligence, crowd control and gathering military intelligence. During the Roman Republic, the Praetorian Guards were escorts for high-ranking political officials and were bodyguards for the senior officers of the Roman legions.

zh.t: 罗马禁卫军刺杀佩蒂纳克斯并拍卖皇位
zh.s: 公元193年3月28日，罗马禁卫军刺杀皇帝佩蒂纳克斯，随后将皇位公开出售，迪迪乌斯·尤利安努斯出价取得皇帝称号。禁卫军原是罗马帝国皇帝的近卫部队，还承担反情报、控制人群和搜集军事情报等任务；在共和国时期，类似卫队则护送高级政要并保卫军团高级将领。

en.s: Publius Helvius Pertinax ( PER-tin-ax; 1 August 126 – 28 March 193) was Roman emperor for the first three months of 193, succeeding Commodus and becoming the first ruler of the turbulent Year of the Five Emperors. The son of a freedman, Pertinax rose from modest origins through a military career. He distinguished himself in the Roman–Parthian War of 161–166 and went on to hold a succession of governorships and senior commands.

zh.s: 普布利乌斯·赫尔维乌斯·佩尔蒂纳克斯生于126年8月1日，卒于193年3月28日，接替康茂德，在193年的头三个月担任罗马皇帝，是动荡的“五帝之年”的首位统治者。他是获释奴隶之子，出身平凡，通过军旅生涯逐步晋升。他在161—166年的罗马与帕提亚战争中表现突出，此后历任多个行省总督及高级军事职务。

en.t: Roman Emperor Valentinian I appoints his brother Flavius Valens co-emperor
en.s: Valentinian I (Latin: Valentinianus; 321 – 17 November 375), sometimes known as Valentinian the Great, was Roman emperor from 364 to 375. He is the second-last emperor to govern the empire as a whole, albeit only from February to March of 364, after which he appointed Valens to rule over the Eastern half of the empire, while he remained in control of the West.

zh.t: 瓦伦提尼安一世任命瓦伦斯为共治皇帝
zh.s: 瓦伦提尼安一世（拉丁语：Valentinianus，321年—375年11月17日）又称瓦伦提尼安大帝，364年至375年在位。他是最后几位统治整个罗马帝国的皇帝之一，但仅在364年2月至3月期间统治全帝国。之后，他任命其弟瓦伦斯统治帝国东部，自己继续统治西部。

en.t: The Great German Pilgrimage, which had been under attack by Bedouin bandits for three days, is rescued by the Fatimid governor of Ramla
en.s: The Great German Pilgrimage of 1064–1065 was a large pilgrimage to Jerusalem which took place a generation before the First Crusade.

zh.t: 遭贝都因劫匪袭击三天的德国大朝圣团获拉姆拉法蒂玛王朝总督救援
zh.s: 1064—1065年德国大朝圣团是一支前往耶路撒冷的大型朝圣队伍，发生在第一次十字军东征前一代人时期。

en.s: The sack of Kraków during the first Mongol invasion of Poland took place on either 22 or 28 March 1241. It ended in the victory of the Mongol forces, who captured the city and burned it, massacring most of its residents.

zh.s: 蒙古军队第一次入侵波兰期间，于1241年3月22日或28日攻占克拉科夫。蒙古军获胜后纵火焚城，并屠杀了城内大多数居民。

en.s: The Battle of Ferrybridge, 28 March 1461, was a preliminary engagement between the houses of York and Lancaster before the larger battle of Towton, during the period known as the Wars of the Roses. After proclaiming himself king, Edward IV gathered together a large force and marched north towards the Lancastrian position behind the Aire River in Yorkshire. On 27 March the Earl of Warwick (leading the vanguard) forced a crossing at Ferrybridge, bridging the gaps (the Lancastrians having previously destroyed it) with planks.

zh.s: 1461年3月28日的费里布里奇战役，是玫瑰战争期间约克家族与兰开斯特家族在陶顿大战前的一次交锋。爱德华四世宣布自己为国王后，集结大军北上，向约克郡艾尔河后方的兰开斯特军阵地推进。3月27日，率领先锋的沃里克伯爵在费里布里奇强行渡河，用木板填补此前被兰开斯特军毁坏的桥面缺口。

en.s: The Battle of Gannoruwa was a battle of the Sinhalese–Portuguese War fought in 1638 between the occupying Portuguese forces and the Sinhalese King's army at Gannoruwa in the District of Kandy, Sri Lanka. The Portuguese had attempted three times without success to capture the Kingdom of Kandy, in order to bring the entire country under their rule. In 1635, Rajasinghe II became the king of Kandy and started negotiations with the Dutch to obtain their help in driving out the Portuguese. The Portuguese hastened their efforts to take Kandy because of this, and Diogo de Melo de Castro, the Portuguese Captain General, tried to provoke the Sinhalese on several occasions.

zh.s: 甘诺鲁沃战役是僧伽罗与葡萄牙战争中的一场战斗，1638年在今斯里兰卡康提区的甘诺鲁沃爆发，由葡萄牙占领军对阵僧伽罗国王的军队。葡萄牙人为统治全岛，曾三次试图征服康提王国，均告失败。拉贾辛哈二世于1635年成为康提国王，开始与荷兰人谈判，寻求帮助驱逐葡萄牙人。葡方因此加紧夺取康提的行动，葡萄牙总司令迪奥戈·德·梅洛·德·卡斯特罗曾多次试图挑起与僧伽罗人的冲突。

en.s: The Battle of Montmeló took place on 28 March 1642 in Montmeló, Catalonia during the Reapers' War. A Franco-Catalan army under the command of Philippe de La Mothe-Houdancourt fought and defeated a smaller Spanish force under Pedro Antonio de Aragón.

zh.s: 刈割者战争期间，法加联军与西班牙军队于1642年3月28日在加泰罗尼亚蒙特梅洛交战。菲利普·德·拉莫特-乌当库尔率领的法加联军击败了由佩德罗·安东尼奥·德·阿拉贡指挥的规模较小的西班牙军队。

en.s: The siege of Kilkenny took place from 22 to 28 March 1650, during the Cromwellian conquest of Ireland. Previously the capital of Confederate Ireland, the garrison surrendered to Commonwealth forces under Oliver Cromwell.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 克伦威尔征服爱尔兰期间，英格兰议会军于1650年3月22日至28日围攻基尔肯尼。基尔肯尼曾是邦联爱尔兰的首都，守军最终向奥利弗·克伦威尔率领的英联邦军队投降。

en.s: The Battle of Nisko took place on March 28, 1656, and was one of battles of the Swedish invasion of Poland. It resulted in a victory of Swedish forces, commanded by King Charles X Gustav. The battle took place during Swedish raid of southern part of the Kingdom of Poland, in which King Charles X Gustav tried to finally destroy Polish forces loyal to King John II Casimir Vasa. The badly organized Swedish campaign was terminated after the Battle of Jaroslaw, when Charles X Gustav decided to order a retreat towards central Poland.

zh.s: 尼斯科战役发生于1656年3月28日，是瑞典入侵波兰期间的一场战斗，最终由国王卡尔十世·古斯塔夫指挥的瑞典军队获胜。瑞军当时正在突袭波兰王国南部，卡尔十世试图彻底消灭效忠扬二世·卡齐米日·瓦萨的波兰军队。但这次组织不善的军事行动在雅罗斯瓦夫战役后结束，卡尔十世决定命令部队向波兰中部撤退。

en.t: Peter the Great's capture of Rasht
en.s: Peter the Great's capture of Rasht (also spelled Resht), occurred between December 1722 and late March 1723 amidst the successful spree of campaigns of Peter the Great during the Russo-Persian War (1722-1723). The capture of Rasht brought the Caspian Sea town alongside the rest of Gilan into Russian possession for a decade, until the Treaty of Resht of 1732, when they would be returned.

zh.s: 俄波战争（1722—1723年）期间，彼得大帝于1722年12月至1723年3月下旬发动一系列战役，并在其间攻占拉什特（又译雷什特）。此后十年，里海沿岸城市拉什特及吉兰地区其余部分归俄罗斯控制，直至1732年《雷什特条约》签订后归还。

en.s: The Battle of Vilshofen was fought on 28 March 1745 between France and Austria. The Austrians won the battle, before plundering Vilshofen. Before the battle, a sizeable number of Bavarians and Hessians, likely numbering around 4,000–6,000 men, curbed Austrian advances for five days. On 28 March 1745, Austrian general Maximilian Ulysses Browne led troops into Vilshofen.

zh.s: 法国与奥地利于1745年3月28日在维尔斯霍芬交战，奥军获胜，随后劫掠了当地。战前，数量不少的巴伐利亚和黑森士兵（可能约4000至6000人）曾阻挡奥军推进五天。3月28日，奥地利将军马克西米利安·乌利塞斯·布朗率军进入维尔斯霍芬。

en.s: The Battle off Yarmouth took place on 28 March 1777 during the American Revolutionary War off the coast of Yarmouth, Nova Scotia. The battle is the first American armed vessel to engage the Royal Navy. British frigate HMS Milford forced the American USS Cabot aground and the American crew escaped among the inhabitants of Yarmouth.

zh.s: 美国独立战争期间，1777年3月28日，双方在新斯科舍省亚茅斯附近海域交战。这是美国武装船只首次与英国皇家海军交战。英国护卫舰“米尔福德”号迫使美国“卡伯特”号搁浅，美方船员逃入亚茅斯居民中。

en.s: The Treaty of Florence (28 March 1801), which followed the Armistice of Foligno (9 February 1801), brought to an end the war between the French Republic and the Kingdom of Naples, one of the Wars of the French Revolution. Forced by the French military presence, Naples ceded some territories in the Tyrrhenian Sea and accepted French garrisons to their ports on the Adriatic Sea.

zh.s: 《佛罗伦萨条约》于1801年3月28日签署，此前双方于2月9日达成《福利尼奥停战协定》。条约结束了法兰西共和国与那不勒斯王国之间的战争，这是法国大革命战争的一部分。法国驻军的军事压力迫使那不勒斯割让第勒尼安海的一些领土，并同意法国在其亚得里亚海港口驻军。

en.s: Pallas (minor-planet designation: 2 Pallas) is the third-largest asteroid in the Solar System by volume and mass. It is the second asteroid to have been discovered, after Ceres, and is likely a remnant protoplanet. Like Ceres, it is believed to have a mineral composition similar to carbonaceous chondrite meteorites, though significantly less hydrated than Ceres.

zh.s: 1802年3月28日，德国天文学家海因里希·奥尔伯斯发现智神星。智神星的小行星编号为2，按体积和质量是太阳系第三大小行星，也是继谷神星之后第二颗被发现的小行星，可能是原行星遗骸。人们认为它与谷神星一样，矿物成分类似碳质球粒陨石，但含水程度明显更低。

en.s: In the Peninsular War, the Battle of Medellín was fought on 28 March 1809 and resulted in a victory of the French under Marshal Victor against the Spanish under General Don Gregorio Garcia de la Cuesta. The battle marked the first major effort by the French to occupy Southern Spain, a feat mostly completed with the victory at the Battle of Ocana later in the year.

zh.s: 1809年3月28日，半岛战争中的梅德林战役爆发。维克托元帅率领的法军击败了格雷戈里奥·加西亚·德·拉奎斯塔将军指挥的西班牙军。这是法军为占领西班牙南部而采取的首次重大行动。同年稍后的奥卡尼亚战役获胜后，法军基本完成了这一目标。

en.s: The Battle of Bajo Palacé was the first major military campaign of the Colombian War of Independence, resulting in a Patriot victory over the Spanish royalist army. The battle was fought on March 28, 1811, on the banks Palacé River where the Palacé bridge crossed the river, located a few kilometers north of the city of Popayan, this bridge was part of the route of the Camino Real that connected the city of Popayan with Cali.

zh.s: 巴霍帕拉塞战役于1811年3月28日在哥伦比亚帕莱塞河畔爆发，地点靠近帕莱塞桥；该桥位于波帕扬以北数公里，处在连接波帕扬和卡利的皇家大道上。这是哥伦比亚独立战争中的首场重大战役，爱国者军队击败西班牙保王党军队。

en.s: The Battle of Valparaíso, also called the Capture of USS Essex, was a naval action fought during the War of 1812. It took place off Valparaíso, Chile on March 28, 1814, between the frigate USS Essex and the sloop USS Essex Junior of the United States Navy and the frigate HMS Phoebe and sloop HMS Cherub of the Royal Navy.

zh.s: 瓦尔帕莱索海战又称埃塞克斯号被俘事件，发生于1812年战争期间。1814年3月28日，在智利瓦尔帕莱索外海，美国海军的护卫舰埃塞克斯号与单桅帆船小埃塞克斯号，同英国皇家海军的护卫舰菲比号和单桅帆船丘鲁布号交战。

en.s: The Battle of Claye took place during the War of the Sixth Coalition. Both sides made advances, but the French force, which was perceived by the Prussians to be much smaller, dealt many casualties to the Prussian troops. Some sources claim the battle was a victory for Prussia, while others claim the battle may have resulted in a French victory.

zh.s: 第六次反法同盟战争期间，双方在克莱战役中都取得进展。普鲁士军队认为法军规模较小，但法军给普军造成了大量伤亡。部分资料称普鲁士获胜，另一些则认为法军可能获胜。

en.s: The Battle of Rodeo del Chacón, fought in Potrero de Chacón, Argentina on 28 March 1831, was a battle during the civil war between Unitarian and Federalist forces. It ended with the victory of General Facundo Quiroga, one of the most capable and well known of the Federalist caudillos.

zh.s: 1831年3月28日，阿根廷内战中的单一派与联邦派在波特雷罗德查孔交战，史称罗德奥德尔查孔战役。联邦派将领法昆多·基罗加获胜，他是联邦派中最有能力、也最著名的地方强人之一。

en.t: French blockade of the Río de la Plata
en.s: The French blockade of the Río de la Plata was a two-year-long naval blockade imposed by France on the Argentine Confederation ruled by Juan Manuel de Rosas. It closed Buenos Aires to naval commerce. It was imposed in 1838 to support the Peru–Bolivian Confederation in the War of the Confederation, but continued after the end of the war.

zh.s: 法国对由胡安·曼努埃尔·德·罗萨斯统治的阿根廷邦联实施了为期两年的海上封锁，切断了布宜诺斯艾利斯的海上贸易。法国于1838年为支持秘鲁-玻利维亚邦联而实施封锁，原本介入邦联战争，但战争结束后封锁仍继续。

en.s: The Action at Hykulzye was an engagement between Afghan insurgents and British troops led by Brigadier-General Richard England at the village of Hykulzye. The Afghans were victorious and the British were repulsed.

zh.s: 阿富汗起义军与英国军队在希库尔泽村交战。理查德·英格兰准将率领英军，阿富汗方面获胜，英军被击退。

en.t: First concert of the Vienna Philharmonic Orchestra, conducted by Otto Nicolai
en.s: Vienna Philharmonic (VPO; German: Wiener Philharmoniker) is an orchestra that was founded in 1842 and has been considered to be one of the finest in the world. The Vienna Philharmonic is based at the Musikverein in Vienna, Austria. Its members are selected from the orchestra of the Vienna State Opera. Selection involves a lengthy process, with each musician demonstrating their capability for a minimum of three years' performance for the opera and ballet.

zh.t: 维也纳爱乐乐团举行首场音乐会，由奥托·尼古莱指挥
zh.s: 维也纳爱乐乐团（VPO；德语：Wiener Philharmoniker）创立于1842年，被认为是世界顶尖乐团之一。乐团驻于奥地利维也纳的金色大厅，其成员从维也纳国家歌剧院管弦乐团中选拔。选拔过程漫长，每位音乐家都必须至少在歌剧和芭蕾演出中工作三年，以证明自己的能力。

en.t: Crimean War: France and Britain declare war on Russia
en.s: The Crimean War was fought between Russia and an alliance of the Ottoman Empire, France, the United Kingdom, and Sardinia from October 1853 to February 1856. Geopolitical causes of the war included the Eastern question (the decline of the Ottoman Empire), the expansion of Russia in the preceding Russo-Turkish wars, and the British and French preference to preserve the Ottoman Empire to maintain the balance of power in the Concert of Europe.

zh.s: 1854年3月28日，英国和法国对俄罗斯宣战，正式加入克里米亚战争。战争从1853年10月持续至1856年2月，俄罗斯对阵由奥斯曼帝国、法国、英国和撒丁王国组成的联盟。战争背景包括奥斯曼帝国衰弱引发的东方问题、俄罗斯此前在俄土战争中的扩张，以及英法为维持欧洲列强力量平衡而希望保全奥斯曼帝国。

en.t: British and colonial forces fight Māori at Waireka
en.s: On March 28, 1860, British regulars, colonial militia and volunteers fought Māori forces at Waireka in New Zealand during the First Taranaki War.

zh.t: 英军及殖民地部队在韦雷卡与毛利人交战
zh.s: 1860年3月28日，英军正规部队、殖民地民兵和志愿兵在新西兰韦雷卡与毛利人部队交战。这是第一次塔拉纳基战争中的一场战斗。

en.s: The 1872 New South Wales colonial election was held between 13 February and 28 March 1872. This election was for all of the 72 seats in the New South Wales Legislative Assembly and it was conducted in 52 single-member constituencies, six 2-member constituencies and two 4-member constituencies, all with a first past the post system.

zh.t: 1872年新南威尔士殖民地议会选举
zh.s: 1872年新南威尔士殖民地议会选举于2月13日至3月28日举行，改选立法议会全部72个席位。选区包括52个单席选区、6个双席选区和2个四席选区，均采用相对多数制。

en.s: The Battle of Hlobane (28 March 1879) took place at Hlobane, near the modern town of Vryheid in KwaZulu-Natal, South Africa during the Anglo-Zulu War.

zh.s: 1879年3月28日，英祖战争期间，双方在赫洛巴内交战。该地位于今南非夸祖鲁-纳塔尔省弗赖黑德镇附近。

en.s: The Battle of Gia Cuc, fought on 27 and 28 March 1883, was a battle in the Tonkin Campaign between the French and Vietnamese, during the period of undeclared hostilities that preceded the Sino-French War (August 1884–April 1885).

zh.s: 1883年3月27日至28日，法国与越南军队在北圻战役中爆发嘉局之战。当时双方尚未正式宣战，处于后来1884年8月至1885年4月中法战争爆发前的敌对阶段。

en.s: Kim Okkyun (Korean: 김옥균; Hanja: 金玉均; February 23, 1851 – March 28, 1894) was a Korean scholar-bureaucrat of the late Joseon period. He was a member of the reformist Gaehwa Party. He served under King Gojong, and actively participated to advance Western European ideas and sciences in Korea. The goal of the reform movement was to develop Korea in government, technology, and military by using foreign resources to help Korea become stable enough to withstand anticipated increases in foreign encroachment.

zh.s: 1894年3月28日，朝鲜改革派政治人物金玉均在上海遭枪杀。他生于1851年，是朝鲜王朝末期的学者型官员、开化党成员，曾在高宗麾下推动引入西欧思想与科学。改革派希望利用外国资源改进国家行政、技术和军备，使朝鲜有能力抵挡预期加剧的外来侵扰。

The tornadoes left at least 153 dead and at least 1,215 injured. Many communities and farmers alike were caught off-guard as the storms moved to the northeast at speeds that reached over 60 mph (97 km/h).

en.s: The Reformed Government of the Republic of China was a puppet state created by Japan that existed in eastern China from 1938 to 1940 during the Second Sino-Japanese War. The regime had little authority or popular support, nor did it receive international recognition even from Japan itself, lasting only two years before it was merged with the Provisional Government into the Reorganized National Government of the Republic of China under Wang Jingwei.

zh.t: 中华民国维新政府成立
zh.s: 日本于1938年3月28日在国民大会堂扶植梁鸿志等人建立中华民国维新政府，并将江苏、浙江、安徽三省以及南京、上海两市划归其管辖。该政权是抗日战争期间日本在中国东部建立的傀儡政权，存在于1938年至1940年。它权力有限、缺乏民众支持，也未获国际承认，甚至未获日本承认。两年后，该政权与中华民国临时政府合并，组成汪精卫政权。

en.s: The Siege of Madrid was a two and a half year siege of the Spanish capital city of Madrid, during the Spanish Civil War of 1936 to 1939. The city, besieged from October 1936, eventually fell to the Francoist armies on 28 March 1939. Madrid was held by various forces loyal to the Spanish Republic and was besieged and subject to aerial bombardment by the rebel faction under General Francisco Franco. The Battle of Madrid in November 1936 saw the most intense fighting in and around the city when the Nationalists made their most determined attempt to take the Republican capital.

zh.s: 马德里围城战发生于1936年至1939年的西班牙内战期间，持续两年半。首都马德里从1936年10月起遭围困，最终于1939年3月28日落入佛朗哥军队之手。城内由忠于西班牙共和国的多支部队守卫，弗朗西斯科·佛朗哥将军领导的叛军则围城并实施空袭。1936年11月的马德里战役是城内外战斗最激烈的阶段，国民军当时全力试图夺取共和国首都。

en.s: Kayyur incident also known as Kayyur uprising or Kayyur Revolt is a series of incidents that occurred in Kayyur village of present-day Kasaragod district during British rule in India. The peaceful farmers protest on 1941 March 28 turned violent and the mob accidentally killed a policeman. 61 were trialed for this violent deed and 4 persons were sentenced to death.

zh.s: 凯尤尔事件又称凯尤尔起义，是英国统治印度期间发生在今喀萨拉戈德县凯尤尔村的一系列事件。1941年3月28日，当地农民和平抗议转为暴力，示威人群意外杀死一名警察。61人因这一暴力事件受审，其中4人被判死刑。

en.s: The St Nazaire Raid or Operation Chariot was a successful British amphibious attack on the heavily defended Normandie dry dock at St Nazaire in German-occupied France during the Second World War. The operation was undertaken by the Royal Navy and British Commandos under the auspices of Combined Operations Headquarters on 28 March 1942. St Nazaire was targeted because the loss of its dry dock would force any large German warship in need of repairs, such as the Tirpitz, to return to home waters via either the English Channel or the GIUK gap, both of which were heavily defended by British units including the Royal Navy's Home Fleet, rather than having a haven available on the Atlantic coast.

zh.s: 圣纳泽尔突袭战又称“战车行动”，是第二次世界大战中英国对德占法国圣纳泽尔防守严密的诺曼底干船坞发动的一次成功两栖袭击。1942年3月28日，英国皇家海军与突击队在联合作战司令部统筹下实施行动。英军选中这里，是因为一旦失去这座干船坞，提尔皮茨号等需要维修的大型德国军舰，便无法在大西洋沿岸找到可用的维修港，只能经英吉利海峡，或格陵兰、冰岛与英国之间的海上通道，返回本国水域。这两条路线都由包括皇家海军本土舰队在内的英军严密防守。

en.s: The Invasion of Sumatra was the assault by Imperial Japanese forces on the Dutch East Indies that took place from 14 February to 28 March 1942. The invasion was part of the Pacific War in South-East Asia during World War II and led to the capture of the island. The invasion of Sumatra was planned to occur prior to the invasion of Java to destroy the west flank of the Allies and to give access to Java.

zh.s: 路易·茹贝尔船闸（法语：Forme Ecluse Louis Joubert），也称诺曼底船坞（得名于促使这座设施建造的大型远洋客轮），是一座船闸和大型干船坞，位于法国西北部卢瓦尔-大西洋省圣纳泽尔港。它归南特—圣纳泽尔港务局所有。1934年建成后，它作为重要海军建造和维修设施具有战略意义，因此成为主要目标。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Romania on 28 March 1948. zh.s: 1967年3月28日，印度果阿、达曼和第乌中央直辖区举行议会选举，选出30名议员。这次选举在1月有关该地区未来地位的民意投票之后举行。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Cameroon on 28 March 1970. The country was a one-party state at the time, with the Cameroonian National Union as the sole legal party. Its leader, Ahmadou Ahidjo, was the only candidate in the election, and won unopposed. Voter turnout was 99.4%.

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Dahomey from 9 March to 28 March 1970. Voting took place "in one province at a time" in Dahomey's six departments. However, on 28 March, the ruling military council suspended further voting because of violence between supporters of the three main candidates. At the time the voting was halted, Justin Ahomadégbé-Tomêtin of Dahomey's had received a plurality of the vote, but disagreements between factions in other parts of the country led to the results being annulled.

en.s: A general election was held in Honduras on March 28, 1971. Voters went to the polls to elect a new President of the Republic and a new Congress. “After considerable discussion and debate, the PLH and PNH parties responded to pressures from labor, business, and the military. On January 7, 1971, they signed a political pact agreeing to establish a national-unity government after the March elections. One of the purposes was to present a single slate of congressional candidates that would divide the Congress equally between the PLH and PNH”.

zh.s: 1971年3月28日，洪都拉斯举行大选，选出新一届总统和国会。自由党与国民党经过多轮讨论和辩论，在劳工、商界及军方压力下，于1971年1月7日签署政治协议，约定在3月选举后成立民族团结政府。其中一个目的，是推出共同的国会候选人名单，让两党平分国会议席。

en.s: The Battle of FSB Mary Ann occurred when Viet Cong (VC) sappers attacked a U.S. firebase located in Quảng Tín Province, South Vietnam early on the morning of 28 March 1971. Fire Support Base (FSB) Mary Ann was established to interdict movement of North Vietnamese People's Army of Vietnam (PAVN) and VC troops and materiel down the K-7 Corridor and Dak Rose Trail (branches of the Ho Chi Minh trail running from Laos to the coast of South Vietnam).

en.s: A presidential election was held in the Socialist Republic of Romania on 28 March 1974. It was the first election held after the post of President of the Republic was created by an amendment to the Constitution earlier in the year. Nicolae Ceaușescu, incumbent General Secretary of the Romanian Communist Party and president of the State Council, was elected by the Great National Assembly as the first President of the Republic on 28 March 1974; he was the only candidate.

zh.s: 罗马尼亚社会主义共和国于1974年3月28日举行总统选举。这是年初修宪设立共和国总统职位后的首次选举。罗马尼亚共产党总书记兼国务委员会主席尼古拉·齐奥塞斯库于当天由大国民议会选为首任共和国总统，他是唯一候选人。

en.s: Stump v. Sparkman, 435 U.S. 349 (1978), is the leading United States Supreme Court decision on judicial immunity. It involved an Indiana judge who was sued by a young woman who had been sterilized without her knowledge as a minor in accordance with the judge's order. The Supreme Court held that the judge was immune from being sued for issuing the order because it was issued as a judicial function.

zh.t: 斯塔姆普诉斯帕克曼案
zh.s: “斯塔姆普诉斯帕克曼案”（435 U.S. 349，1978年）是美国最高法院关于司法豁免权的代表性判决。案件涉及一名印第安纳州法官：一名年轻女子因未成年时在不知情的情况下依照法官命令接受绝育手术而起诉该法官。最高法院裁定，法官因履行司法职能而作出的命令享有豁免，不能因此被起诉。

en.s: The Three Mile Island accident was a partial nuclear meltdown that occurred on March 28, 1979, in reactor number 2 of Three Mile Island Nuclear Generating Station (TMI-2) in Dauphin County, Pennsylvania, United States. It was the most significant accident in U.S. commercial nuclear power plant history. The incident was rated a five on the seven-point International Nuclear Event Scale: Accident With Wider Consequences. The accident began with failures in the non-nuclear secondary system, followed by a stuck-open pilot-operated relief valve in the primary system, which allowed large amounts of nuclear reactor coolant to escape.

zh.s: 1979年3月28日，美国宾夕法尼亚州多芬县三里岛核电站二号反应堆发生部分堆芯熔毁。这是美国商用核电站历史上最严重的事故，在共七级的国际核事件分级中被定为第五级，即“具有较广泛影响的事故”。事故始于非核部分的二回路系统故障，随后一回路的先导式泄压阀卡在开启位置，导致大量反应堆冷却剂流失。

en.t: The British House of Commons passes a vote of no confidence against James Callaghan's government by one vote, precipitating a general election
en.s: A vote of no confidence in the British Labour government of James Callaghan occurred on 28 March 1979. The vote was brought by the Official Opposition leader Margaret Thatcher and was lost by the Labour government by one vote (311 votes to 310), which was announced at 10:19 pm. The result mandated a general election that was won by Thatcher's Conservative Party.

zh.t: 英国下议院以一票之差通过对詹姆斯·卡拉汉政府的不信任案
zh.s: 英国下议院于1979年3月28日就詹姆斯·卡拉汉领导的工党政府举行不信任投票。反对党领袖玛格丽特·撒切尔提出动议，工党政府以311票对310票、一票之差落败。结果于当晚10时19分宣布，随后举行大选，由撒切尔领导的保守党获胜。

en.s: A by-election for the seat of MacDonnell in the Northern Territory Legislative Assembly was held on 28 March 1981. The by-election was triggered by the resignation of Labor Party member Neville Perkins, the first indigenous person in Australia to hold a shadow ministry in an Australian parliament. The seat had been held by Perkins since 1977. The CLP selected Aboriginal film activist Rosalie Kunoth-Monks, as its candidate.

en.s: Operation Fath-ol-Mobin (Persian: عملیات فتح‌المبین, a Quranic phrase meaning "Undeniable Victory" or "Manifest Victory") was a major Iranian military operation conducted during the Iran–Iraq War, in March 1982 and resulted to the Battle of Shush. The operation was led by Lt. General Ali Sayad Shirazi and was conducted in four phases. Some believe that this operation was the turning point in the war and that it led to the eviction of Iraqi troops from Khuzestan.

en.s: Leopoldov prison uprising was the largest prison uprising in the former Czechoslovakia, which took place in 1990. The army was also deployed to suppress it. It was started by the amnesty of Václav Havel. It did not apply to all prisoners. The suppression of the rebellion drew admiration from foreign experts. Nevertheless, some journalists and politicians described the strike against prisoners as brutal, and the commander was dismissed.

en.s: French legislative elections took place on 21 and 28 March 1993 to elect the tenth National Assembly of the Fifth Republic. Since 1988, President François Mitterrand and his Socialist cabinets had relied on a relative parliamentary majority. In an attempt to avoid having to work with the Communists, Prime Minister Michel Rocard tried to gain support from the UDF by appointing four UDF ministers. After the UDF withdrew its support for the government in 1991, Rocard and the UDF ministers resigned. The UDF then became allied with the Gaullist Rally for the Republic (RPR).

zh.s: 法国于1993年3月21日和28日举行选举，选出第五共和国第十届国民议会。自1988年起，总统弗朗索瓦·密特朗及其社会党内阁一直依靠议会相对多数执政。为避免与共产党合作，总理米歇尔·罗卡尔曾任命四名法国民主联盟成员为部长，以争取该联盟支持。1991年，法国民主联盟撤回支持，罗卡尔及该联盟的部长随后辞职。法国民主联盟此后转而与戴高乐派的保卫共和联盟结盟。

en.s: The 1994 Italian general election was held on 27 and 28 March 1994 to elect members of the Chamber of Deputies and the Senate of the Republic for the 12th legislature. Silvio Berlusconi's centre-right coalition won a large majority in the Chamber of Deputies but just missed winning a majority in the Senate. The Italian People's Party, the official heir of Christian Democracy party, which had dominated Italian politics for almost half a century, was decimated.

zh.s: 1994年3月27日和28日，意大利举行大选，选出第12届议会的众议员和参议员。西尔维奥·贝卢斯科尼领导的中右翼联盟在众议院取得明显多数，但在参议院未能过半。曾主导意大利政治近半个世纪的天主教民主党，其正式继承者意大利人民党在此次选举中惨败。

en.t: Zhongshan station opens as Tamsui Line terminus

en.s: WrestleMania XV was the fifteenth annual WrestleMania professional wrestling pay-per-view event produced by the World Wrestling Federation (WWF), which took place on March 28, 1999, at the First Union Center in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania. Ten professional wrestling matches were scheduled on the event's card. The main event saw the challenger Stone Cold Steve Austin face The Rock in a No Disqualification match for the WWF Championship. The penultimate match saw The Undertaker wrestle Big Boss Man in a Hell in a Cell match. Lower on the card, six of the seven active championships were defended, including the first WrestleMania defense of the Hardcore Championship.

zh.s: 第十五届摔角狂热是世界摔角联盟（WWF）制作的年度职业摔角按次付费赛事，于1999年3月28日在美国宾夕法尼亚州费城第一联合中心举行。赛事安排了十场比赛。压轴赛中，挑战者“冷石”史蒂夫·奥斯汀与巨石强森进行无取消资格赛，争夺WWF冠军。倒数第二场为送葬者与大老板进行的地狱铁笼赛。其他比赛涉及当时七项有效冠军中的六项卫冕战，其中硬核冠军首次在摔角狂热上接受挑战。

en.t: 190th Fighter Squadron, Blues and Royals friendly fire incident
en.s: The 190th Fighter Squadron, Blues and Royals friendly fire incident was a friendly fire incident involving two United States Air Force (USAF) Air National Guard 190th Fighter Squadron attack aircraft, and vehicles from the United Kingdom's D Squadron, The Blues and Royals of the Household Cavalry, and took place on 28 March 2003 during the invasion of Iraq by armed forces of the United States and United Kingdom. en.s: Regional elections in were held in France on 21 and 28 March 2004. At stake were the presidencies of each of France's 26 regions which, although they do not have legislative powers, manage sizeable budgets. The results were a triumph for the parties of the left, led by the French Socialist Party (PS) in alliance with minor parties including the French Communist Party (PCF), the Left Radical Party (PRG) and The Greens (Les Verts). Teresa Harding was elected mayor with 62.98% of the vote after preferences, becoming the first non-Labor Party aligned Ipswich mayor in 50 years.

en.s: The 2020 Townsville City Council election was held on 28 March 2020 to elect a mayor and 10 councillors to the City of Townsville. The election was held as part of the statewide local elections in Queensland, Australia. Team Jenny Hill won all but one wards, with their only loss coming in Division 2. Hill was also re-elected mayor, winning 61.53% of the vote after preferences.

en.s: On March 28, 2025, jihadists from Jama'at Nusrat al-Islam wal-Muslimin attacked Burkinabe forces at Diapaga, Est Region, Burkina Faso, killing at least sixty soldiers. The attack was revenge for the massacre of over 130 civilians at Solenzo on March 11.

en.s: On 28 March 2025, at 12:50:52 MMT (06:20:52 UTC), a moment magnitude (Mw) 7.7–7.9 earthquake struck the Sagaing Region of Myanmar, with an epicenter close to Mandalay, the country's second-largest city. The shaking caused by this strike-slip shock reached a maximum Modified Mercalli intensity of X (Extreme). It was the most powerful earthquake to strike Myanmar since 1912, and the second deadliest in Myanmar's modern history, surpassed only by upper estimates of the 1930 Bago earthquake.

zh.s: 2025年3月28日12时50分52秒（缅甸时间；协调世界时06时20分52秒），缅甸实皆省发生矩震级7.7至7.9级地震，震中靠近该国第二大城市曼德勒。此次走滑型地震的最大麦加利烈度达到X级（极强）。这是缅甸自1912年以来最强的地震，也是该国现代史上死亡人数第二多的地震，仅次于1930年勃固地震死亡人数的最高估计。
